name: Geneva-tail knuckle on the pin knee: link 2's rear tail turns K through a one-tooth drive, so q2's encoder determines K (3 active, no K sensor)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle)
verdict: SCREENED, promising at 3 active - in its FALLBACK embodiment (hub-2 rim lobe -> rocker -> O3 pushrod -> horn on K's cap; K slaved, never read). Best 16.53 fast near-touch (= plain, min metal 1.05 mm; reach 0.794, follow 1.0, in-band 0.846, contact 0.005). Frozen exact Bench(110,360) 23.37 (score 91.5; near-touch 25.01, reach 0.731, overhead 8/28, min metal 0.45 mm), against H1's 27.20 on the same round-3 protocol (24.48 polish protocol). The 3-active class has a measured route below H1, at complexity 42.5 against 21.5. The Geneva TAIL embodiment is NOT viable: honest tail metal costs 10-42 points (best 28.66 fast / 37.00 frozen), because a follower rigid with link 2 sweeps a cone about u2. Needs the independent verifier, the continuity flood fill and held-out before any claim.
limiter: Rod embodiment: the fold, which still takes 84 of 112 lost poses frozen (stretched past stop B at a1max 58; folded side has no lobe), and in-band 0.846. The 51 rod and rod-end samples sit 20-22 mm over the skin (0 % in band); hub 3 is 0.59; L2 is 0.77. Tail embodiment: its sweep cone about u2 (the highest skin under it, link 1b crossed, K's cap climbed).
note: Model: kit-rule B (phys q2 stop, capK 6, pin knee, near-touch objective) with the stretched stop replaced by the exact spatial contact law. The flank half-plane passes through K's axis on link 1a, and the roller is on a small circle about u2. Per-t gates: monotone, rate <= 3.45, pressure angle <= 45, tooth extent, K stop B, and lift-off (self-motion slope). One tooth (no folded lobe). Tail strap LT 8 x 3, skin-fitted, in band. The roller boss O8 x 3 is sampled. Pairs: LT and roller vs hub 1 / K (cap) / hub 3 / L1a / L1b / knee / pad / E. Search: 4 hand checks + farm LHS 256 (bk1, bk2, a1max, smhi, smlo, d, psi_c) + 256 local perturbations of the top 8, half of them also moving the J1/J2/J3 seats. Convergence gate on 506 tries: gain over the 2nd half 0.55, over the last third 0.02, top-5 spread 0.55 (passes, but it is a 2-stage search, not CMA). Red team: (1) the TIP need is set by ONE workspace pose. Coupling it into the greedy pose drop gave 35.15 vs 30.72, so the shape choice is kept. (2) Local vs farm differ by 0.5 at the coarse best (30.72 vs 30.18). (3) r_law 70 mm is used in the law, and the real tip radius differs (rho/r effect < 0.5 deg). (4) K's stack flip is not applied to the link levels (L1a / L1b swap 3.15 mm at K, a wash to first order). (5) The roller axis must stay parallel to the flank, but the tail turns about u2 at 26-47 deg to uK, so a crowned roller (point contact) is needed. Frozen exact Bench(110,360): see the doc (running at report time). Fallback (lobe-rocker pushrod, kK <= 3.5) not built: the cost is the tail's sweep, and a rim lobe + rocker + pushrod rides the same link-1b strip. | ROD (fallback, built 13:20-13:50 UTC): law dK = kK t (constant-pressure spiral lobe, tan pa = kK r_horn / r_lobe <= 1), gates as the tail. Metal: rocker O10 x 9 on link 1b beside hub 2 (base disc in band), O3 rod + M3 rod-end heads O10 x 5 from the rocker top to the horn on K's cap (sampled rigid with link 1b; its 1-2 mm slide ignored), pairs vs hub 1 / hub 3 / L1a / L2 / knee / pad / E. Search: hand LB1 kK 3 20.37 (law only 15.71), rod LHS 256 (21.18), rod-low LHS 256 (rod at strap level, horn lug r 16-19, rocker ratio 3: 19.94), rod CMA 4 x 8-proc farm jobs (16.45 at r_horn 2.08 rejected as unbuildable; 16.53 at r_horn 2.49 kept). Gate on the rod search (1957 tries): 0.36 / 0.00 / 0.19, passes. Frozen LB1 kK 3: 26.98. RED TEAM: (1) the tail CMA settled on idle-drive rows (16.10: no valid law prefix -> plain 3R with a spare hub, L1b with 0 samples) - excluded; the model now flags an idle drive dishonest. (2) r_horn >= 2.45 enforced by hand after the CMA (the O3 rod-end pin on the cap over the MR117 axle). (3) Open for the verifier: continuity flood fill (K slaved, no redundancy, but the onset transition must be checked), held-out clips, the rod's slide / horn arc, spring vs gravity, the reflected J2 torque kK tau_K. | VERIFIED 2026-10-16 (skeptic, docs/concepts/verify/geneva-tail-knuckle-pinknee-3r.py): the rod best reproduces to the digit (16.53 fast, 23.37 frozen exact Bench(110,360)). Corrected model: the claim's horn sat at K's cap MID-height, inside the clock-spring housing (capK 6), and its rod ran 5.9 mm into K's cap (rod vs hub K was never checked). The horn moves onto a 1.5 mm plate on the cap top, the rod meets both rod-end heads at mid-height, the rocker post grows 9 -> 19 mm until the rod clears the cap by 1 mm, and ROD-hubK is checked. v_gap 23.57 frozen exact (score 91.4; reach 0.731, follow 1.0, ib14 0.844, ib10 0.531, contact 0.011; near-touch 25.21; min metal 0.45 mm; overhead reach 0.286 = 8/28; lost: fold 84, slide 8, parts 1, contact 4) vs CHAMPION 64.93 on the same bench and protocol (docs/concepts/verify/minarc-skeptic/champbig_frozen_m5.json; 75.94 with the risley checks). Not refuted. Same-protocol references: H1 27.20 (3 active), minarc pick1 18.40 / BDp 19.54 (4 active, K sensed). Continuity flood fill: full envelope grid 0 dropped (406 forced envelope nodes all connected) -> connected 23.57; knn 9 dropped -> 26.10; literal bench grid 82 dropped (16 with no taken neighbour, a subsample artefact) -> 46.65. Held out (disjoint clips + ws): 28.12 corrected (27.92 claim) vs H1 31.39, pick1 21.31-22.69. Law: closure residual <= 0.015 deg, K driven to 44.0 deg taken (law to 53.4, ends on stop B), no idle drive (123 stretched poses). 3 active (K slaved by the lobe, not read), 0 passive translations. Open (not scored): rod / lobe play maps to K error ~1.2 deg per 0.05 mm at r_horn 2.49; the lobe grows to ~10.9 mm radius at full stroke, 0.9 mm past the O20 skirt; spring vs gravity and the reflected J2 torque (3.18 tau_K) not checked; complexity 42.5 vs H1 21.5.
